author: insanegguy
body:
Hey so with OCN gone and me trying to get back into competitive team pvp i thought i'd post an LFT here.

PVP: I'd say my bow skills are probably 8/10 and my sword skills 8/10

Experience: On avicus my only previous team is the powerpuffboys team that won a tourney, on OCN I've been on Weakeners, Beijing, Sandals and several teams in between tourneys.

Position: I prefer frontlines and offense

Timezone: EST
